name: Qatari Investors Group Q.P.S.C.
summary: Qatari Investors Group Q.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a diversified conglomerate company in Qatar. It operates through Real Estate, Marine Services, Industrial, Contracting and Technology, and Other segments.
